# Pinaxium: local image generation (ComfyUI) — MCP reference

<!-- generated by tools_docs.py from the live server; edit the code, then run `uv run python tools_docs.py` -->

Server `pinaxium` version 0.3.0, protocol 2025-11-25.

## Instructions sent to clients

These are delivered to the client at connection time; agents see them as the server's usage guide.

> Pinaxium generates and edits images locally on this machine's GPU through ComfyUI. Nothing leaves the machine (except via run_workflow, see below).
> 
> Workflow:
> 1. list_models: pick a model by its capabilities and notes (speed, lettering quality, editing, transparency). Omit `model` to use the default.
> 2. generate_image (text to image) or edit_image (change an image, or compose from several reference images; only models with capabilities.edit).
> 3. Check the result before presenting it: the reply carries the saved path, a pinaxium:// resource link to the full-size PNG and a preview. Use view_image with crop to inspect lettering, hands or faces at full resolution.
> 4. Iterate: the reply reports the seed; reuse it with a changed prompt for controlled variations, or omit it for new ones.
> 
> Prompting: detailed natural-language descriptions work best (subject, setting, style, lighting, composition). Put text that must appear in the image in quotes. negative_prompt only matters when cfg_scale > 1; the distilled/turbo models run at 1.
> 
> Timing: the engine is stopped while idle. The first request starts it (about 10-20 s) and loads the model; switching models reloads. Renders run one at a time, shared with other clients. Time grows with pixel count and steps: prefer 1024x1024-class sizes and turbo/distilled models for drafts. If a render outlives max_wait_s you get a job_id: collect it with get_job.
> 
> When something fails: tool errors say what to fix. engine_status reports setup_problems (and the config file) when the engine can't start; the pinaxium://logs/comfyui resource shows ComfyUI's own errors.
> 
> Engine control: stop_engine frees all GPU memory now (it also ends other clients' renders); free_vram unloads models but keeps the engine; it stops by itself after the configured idle time.
> 
> run_workflow runs an arbitrary ComfyUI graph and is open-world: partner API nodes call paid external services and custom nodes can run any code. Use it only when the built-in tools can't do the job and the user wants it.

### engine_status

**Engine status**

Report whether the engine is stopped, starting, ready to render, or external (a ComfyUI this server didn't start, which it uses but never stops), plus GPU memory, whether models are loaded, the queue, idle time, the config file in use and, if the engine can't start, setup_problems saying how to fix them. Never starts the engine.

No parameters.

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `engine_url` | string | ComfyUI HTTP endpoint the engine uses |
| `idle_shutdown_minutes` | number | The engine stops after this long without requests or jobs |
| `status` | `stopped` \| `starting` \| `ready` \| `external` | stopped: not running (starts on the next request); starting: booting; ready: running and started by this server; external: a ComfyUI this server didn't start is on the port, used but never shut down |
| `ready_to_render` | boolean | True when renders can be submitted now (status ready or external) |
| `busy` | boolean \| null | A render is running (only while the engine is up) |
| `queued_jobs` | integer \| null | Jobs waiting behind the running one |
| `gpu` | string \| null | GPU name as ComfyUI reports it |
| `vram_used_gb` | number \| null | Whole-GPU memory in use by all processes, GB |
| `vram_total_gb` | number \| null | Total GPU memory, GB |
| `comfyui_version` | string \| null | Version of the running ComfyUI |
| `models_loaded_estimate` | boolean \| null | True when GPU memory beyond the engine's idle baseline suggests models are loaded (an estimate: other programs' GPU memory counts too) |
| `vram_used_by_models_gb` | number \| null | GPU memory above the idle engine's baseline, GB |
| `idle_minutes` | number \| null | Minutes since the last request (managed engine only) |
| `last_stop_reason` | string \| null | Why the engine last stopped, e.g. idle, stop requested, or a startup failure |
| `note` | string \| null | Extra information about the engine's state |
| `config_file` | string \| null | Settings file in use (see `python -m pinaxium.config`) |
| `setup_problems` | array of string \| null | What prevents the engine from starting, and how to fix it |

### start_engine

**Start engine**

Start the engine now (otherwise it starts on the first render) and wait until it is ready to render. Models load into VRAM on the first render, not here. Does nothing if it is already running.

No parameters.

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `engine_url` | string | ComfyUI HTTP endpoint the engine uses |
| `idle_shutdown_minutes` | number | The engine stops after this long without requests or jobs |
| `status` | `stopped` \| `starting` \| `ready` \| `external` | stopped: not running (starts on the next request); starting: booting; ready: running and started by this server; external: a ComfyUI this server didn't start is on the port, used but never shut down |
| `ready_to_render` | boolean | True when renders can be submitted now (status ready or external) |
| `busy` | boolean \| null | A render is running (only while the engine is up) |
| `queued_jobs` | integer \| null | Jobs waiting behind the running one |
| `gpu` | string \| null | GPU name as ComfyUI reports it |
| `vram_used_gb` | number \| null | Whole-GPU memory in use by all processes, GB |
| `vram_total_gb` | number \| null | Total GPU memory, GB |
| `comfyui_version` | string \| null | Version of the running ComfyUI |
| `models_loaded_estimate` | boolean \| null | True when GPU memory beyond the engine's idle baseline suggests models are loaded (an estimate: other programs' GPU memory counts too) |
| `vram_used_by_models_gb` | number \| null | GPU memory above the idle engine's baseline, GB |
| `idle_minutes` | number \| null | Minutes since the last request (managed engine only) |
| `last_stop_reason` | string \| null | Why the engine last stopped, e.g. idle, stop requested, or a startup failure |

### stop_engine

**Stop engine**

Shut the engine down now and release all GPU memory. It restarts on the next request. A running render and queued jobs are lost, including other clients' (the engine is shared). A ComfyUI this server didn't start is left running.

No parameters.

### free_vram

**Free GPU memory**

Unload models from GPU and system memory (and clear ComfyUI's node cache) but keep the engine running; the next render reloads them.

No parameters.

### list_models

**List image models**

List the image models found in ComfyUI's model folders, default model first: each one's id (pass it as `model`), family, capabilities (editing, reference-image limit, transparency, lettering quality, largest size), default steps/cfg, notes comparing it with the others, files and license; models that can't be used yet and what they are missing; and other files found (LoRAs, unsupported architectures). New model files are picked up automatically. Works while the engine is stopped.

No parameters.

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `models` | array of ModelInfo | Usable and not-yet-usable models, default model first |
| `other_files` | array of OtherFile | Model files that aren't part of a usable model |

`ModelCapabilities`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `text_to_image` | boolean | Works with generate_image |
| `edit` | boolean | Works with edit_image |
| `max_side` | integer | Largest supported image side in pixels |
| `max_reference_images` | integer \| null | Most reference images edit_image accepts |
| `transparency` | boolean | Supports transparent=True |
| `text_rendering` | string \| null | How reliably it renders lettering: strong, good or weak |

`ModelDefaults`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `variant` | string | Which version of the family this file is: base, turbo or distilled |
| `steps` | integer | Sampling steps used when a request doesn't set steps |
| `cfg` | number | Guidance scale used when a request doesn't set cfg_scale |

`ModelFiles`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `unet` | string | Diffusion model file |
| `clip` | string \| null | Text encoder file (null if missing) |
| `vae` | string \| null | VAE file (null if missing) |

`ModelInfo`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | Pass as `model` to generate_image / edit_image |
| `family` | string | Model family, e.g. Qwen-Image 2.1 |
| `available` | boolean | All files present; usable now |
| `defaults` | ModelDefaults | Settings used unless a request overrides them |
| `capabilities` | ModelCapabilities | What the model can do |
| `files` | ModelFiles | Files the model runs with |
| `license` | string | The model's license (Pinaxium itself is MIT) |
| `notes` | string | How it compares: strengths, limits and relative speed, to choose a model |
| `missing` | array of string | Companion files needed before it can be used |

`OtherFile`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `file` | string | File name |
| `folder` | string | ComfyUI models subfolder it is in |
| `size_gb` | number | File size, GB |
| `note` | string | Why it isn't offered as a model |

### generate_image

**Generate image**

Generate an image from a text prompt. Waits for the render (starting the engine and loading the model first if needed) up to max_wait_s.

Reply, in order: a text block with the saved file's path, size and mode, the settings used (model, steps, seed, cfg), the render time and the job_id; a resource link to the full-size PNG (pinaxium://images/...); and a preview (max 1024 px) unless include_preview is false. If the render is still running at max_wait_s, the reply is just the job_id for get_job.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes |  | non-empty | What to draw: a detailed natural-language description. Quoted text ("...") is rendered as lettering by models that can. |
| `model` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | A model id from list_models; the default model when omitted. |
| `negative_prompt` | string |  | `''` |  | Things to avoid. Only has an effect when cfg_scale > 1. |
| `width` | integer |  | `1024` | 256–2048 | Output width in pixels (rounded to a multiple of 16). Render time grows with pixel count. |
| `height` | integer |  | `1024` | 256–2048 | Output height in pixels (rounded to a multiple of 16). |
| `steps` | integer \| null |  | `None` | 1–100 | Sampling steps; the model's default when omitted. |
| `seed` | integer \| null |  | `None` | 0– | Fix for reproducible results; random when omitted (the seed used is reported). |
| `cfg_scale` | number \| null |  | `None` | 0.0–20.0 | Guidance scale; the model's default when omitted (1.0 for distilled/turbo models). |
| `transparent` | boolean |  | `False` |  | Keep an alpha channel (models with capabilities.transparency only); say 'transparent background' in the prompt. Otherwise results are plain RGB. |
| `include_preview` | boolean |  | `True` |  | Return a downscaled preview (max 1024 px) of each saved image as image content, besides its path. |
| `max_wait_s` | number |  | `300` | 1–3600 | Seconds to wait for the render; if it isn't done by then a job_id is returned for get_job. |

### edit_image

**Edit image**

Edit an image, or compose a new one from several reference images, following an instruction (refer to them as image 1, image 2, ... in the order given). Only models whose capabilities.edit is true can do this, with at most their max_reference_images.

References can be any image file ComfyUI reads (PNG, JPEG, WebP) and are copied into ComfyUI's input folder. The output has the first reference's aspect ratio at about resolution x resolution pixels. The reply is the same as generate_image's.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | string | yes |  | non-empty | The instruction, e.g. "make it night time" or "put the person from image 1 in the jacket from image 2". |
| `image_paths` | array of string | yes |  | 1–10 items | Absolute paths of local reference images (1 to the model's max_reference_images); the first sets the output's aspect ratio. |
| `model` | string \| null |  | `None` |  | A model id from list_models whose capabilities.edit is true; the default model when omitted. |
| `negative_prompt` | string |  | `''` |  | Things to avoid. Only has an effect when cfg_scale > 1. |
| `resolution` | integer |  | `1024` | 256–2048 | Output pixel budget as one side of a square (1024 means about 1 megapixel), at the first reference's aspect ratio. |
| `steps` | integer \| null |  | `None` | 1–100 | Sampling steps; the model's default when omitted. |
| `seed` | integer \| null |  | `None` | 0– | Fix for reproducible results; random when omitted (the seed used is reported). |
| `cfg_scale` | number \| null |  | `None` | 0.0–20.0 | Guidance scale; the model's default when omitted (1.0 for distilled/turbo models). |
| `transparent` | boolean |  | `False` |  | Keep an alpha channel (models with capabilities.transparency only); say 'transparent background' in the prompt. Otherwise results are plain RGB. |
| `include_preview` | boolean |  | `True` |  | Return a downscaled preview (max 1024 px) of each saved image as image content, besides its path. |
| `max_wait_s` | number |  | `300` | 1–3600 | Seconds to wait for the render; if it isn't done by then a job_id is returned for get_job. |

### run_workflow

**Run ComfyUI workflow**

Run an arbitrary ComfyUI workflow, for models or features the built-in tools don't cover (LoRAs, ControlNet, unsupported architectures). The graph is ComfyUI's API format, as written by ComfyUI's "Export (API)". Returns every image the workflow saved or previewed, like generate_image.

Unlike the other tools this is open-world and destructive: ComfyUI's bundled partner API nodes call external paid services (OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and others), installed custom nodes can run arbitrary code with network access, and nodes can write or overwrite files. The workflow runs exactly as given: use it only when the built-in tools can't do the job.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `workflow` | object | yes |  |  | ComfyUI API-format graph: {node_id: {"class_type": ..., "inputs": {...}}}. Model file names must match those shown by list_models. |
| `include_preview` | boolean |  | `True` |  | Return a downscaled preview (max 1024 px) of each saved image as image content, besides its path. |
| `max_wait_s` | number |  | `300` | 1–3600 | Seconds to wait for the render; if it isn't done by then a job_id is returned for get_job. |

### get_job

**Get render result**

Check a render that outlived max_wait_s. Its state is queued, running, done (the reply then is the same as generate_image's), error (with ComfyUI's message) or unknown. Job state lives in the engine: once the engine has stopped, find the result with list_images instead.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `job_id` | string | yes |  | non-empty | The job_id returned by a render that outlived max_wait_s. |
| `include_preview` | boolean |  | `True` |  | Return a downscaled preview (max 1024 px) of each saved image as image content, besides its path. |

### cancel_render

**Cancel render**

Interrupt the render that is currently running; its result is lost. Queued jobs stay queued.

No parameters.

### list_images

**List saved images**

List the most recent images saved by this server (its output folder, `<base_dir>/output/pinaxium`), newest first, with path, modification time and size. Works while the engine is stopped; each image is also readable at full size as the resource pinaxium://images/<file name>.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | integer |  | `20` | 1–200 | How many to return. |

Structured result (`structuredContent`; the same JSON is also sent as text):

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `images` | array of ImageEntry | Newest first |

`ImageEntry`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | Full path of the saved PNG |
| `modified` | string | Local time, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS |
| `bytes` | integer | File size in bytes |

### view_image

**View image**

Look at a local image, e.g. a result, to check it before showing the user. Returns a text block with its path, full size and mode, then the image itself (JPEG, or PNG if it has transparency), downscaled to max_side. With crop, only that region is returned, at full resolution when it fits in max_side. Reads any image file this server's process can read, not only its own results.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path` | string | yes |  | non-empty | Path of a local image file, e.g. from a render or list_images. |
| `crop` | array of integer \| null |  | `None` | 4–4 items | Optional [x, y, width, height] in pixels of the full-size image, to inspect a detail (text, hands, faces) at full resolution. |
| `max_side` | integer |  | `1568` | 64–1568 | Longest side of the returned image in pixels. |

## Resources

| URI | Name | MIME type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pinaxium://engine/status` | Engine status | application/json | Same as the engine_status tool. Subscribe to be notified when the engine starts, stops, gets busy or loads models. |
| `pinaxium://logs/comfyui` | ComfyUI log | text/plain | Tail of the engine's log (last 256 KB): node errors, model loading, timings. |
| `pinaxium://logs/supervisor` | Supervisor log | text/plain | Tail of the engine supervisor's log: start, idle shutdown and spawn problems. |
| `pinaxium://images/{filename}` (template) | Saved image (full size) | image/png | A full-size PNG saved by this service, by file name (see resources/list or list_images). |

Resource capabilities: subscribe = true, listChanged = true. Saved images are listed individually by `resources/list` (newest 500) under `pinaxium://images/`.
